nodes.label: Workbench
nodes.rationale: Has a floating board in its area; its interaction prompt triggers too broadly and obstructs storage access.

nodes.label: Floating Billboard Text
nodes.rationale: Floating billboard text is visually obstructive.

nodes.label: Sign Text (Bus, Museum, Shop, Tide & Trove, Open/Closed)
nodes.rationale: Text on in-world signs looks out of place with the rest of the art style.

nodes.label: Settings Menu
nodes.rationale: Page 2 uses a different font from the rest of the settings.

nodes.label: Gem Display
nodes.rationale: Gems only display one at a time instead of individually.

nodes.label: Amber
nodes.rationale: Should be a collectible fossil type instead of a direct money source.

nodes.label: Game Map
nodes.rationale: Some areas have a blue floor and edge rock barriers can be walked through.

nodes.label: Bus Stop
nodes.rationale: Street lamp clips the trash can, poster clips the shelter, bench floats.

nodes.label: Bench Model
nodes.rationale: Has a strange hook structure and an oversized hitbox that cannot be jumped over.

nodes.label: Curator's Field Guide GUI
nodes.rationale: Takes up too much of the screen and does not work before the player visits the Curator's Desk.

nodes.label: GUI Title Plate Alignment
nodes.rationale: GUI titles are not aligned with their title plates.

nodes.label: Bottom-Right UI Element
nodes.rationale: Should be removed.

nodes.label: Unpainted Texture Gaps
nodes.rationale: Sloppy textures leave white unpainted spaces.

nodes.label: Equipment Shop
nodes.rationale: Random floating objects nearby, stray arrow/stick objects, and a misaligned roof.

nodes.label: Tide & Trove
nodes.rationale: Sign support poles clip through the sign.

nodes.label: Museum
nodes.rationale: Z-fighting inside, stray potted plants and black rectangles on the porch, grass through the path.

nodes.label: Black Line / Rectangle Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Black lines on prep lab fences and the sidewalk, black rectangles above porch poles.

nodes.label: Prep Lab
nodes.rationale: Fences lack collision and some show black lines.

nodes.label: Mesh Interpenetration (Objects Phasing Through Each Other)
Missing / Broken Collision
nodes.rationale: Doors, poles, fences and edge barriers can be walked through; bench hitboxes are too large.

nodes.label: First-Person Arm Model & Animations
nodes.rationale: Arm model looks strange, only the shove is animated, and the left arm pops in during shove/shovel animations.

nodes.label: NPC Model & Waving Animation
nodes.rationale: NPC model looks strange and the wave animation is unnatural.

nodes.label: Storage
nodes.rationale: Should open as a GUI with two-way transfer to the backpack instead of a one-way unload, and should list cleaned fossils.

nodes.label: Look-At Interaction Prompt Range
nodes.rationale: Prompts should only appear when the player is near and looking directly at the object, because broad ranges (e.g. the workbench) obstruct other interactions such as storage.

nodes.label: Inventory
nodes.rationale: The cleaned fossils tab should be removed from the inventory.

nodes.label: Cleaned Fossils
nodes.rationale: Not shown in storage; should move from an inventory tab to storage.

nodes.label: Physical Trash Pickup
nodes.rationale: Litter the player can pick up and throw into the trash bin.

nodes.label: Hotbar
nodes.rationale: Displays carried items; held items should be trashable except vital tools; held items should render in hand; one extra slot per star via upgrades.

nodes.label: Backpack
nodes.rationale: Items should move both ways between backpack and inventory/storage.

nodes.label: Upgrade Tree
nodes.rationale: Should be a true prerequisite tree: icons connected by lines, click to show name/description/price with an unlock button, no buying a child before its parent, some nodes unlock several children, split into 1-5 star tiers that are unpurchasable without that star rating.

nodes.label: Build Menu
nodes.rationale: Unaffordable items should be grayed out and unclickable.

nodes.label: Vital Tools (Pickaxe, Shovel, Metal Detector)
nodes.rationale: Cannot be trashed from the hotbar.

nodes.label: Held Item Display
nodes.rationale: Held hotbar items should be shown in first person instead of the bare hand.

nodes.label: Hanged Shell Displays
nodes.rationale: Off-center in their frames and far too many of them.

nodes.label: 'Auto' Display Option
nodes.rationale: Feedback asks to remove the 'auto' option; it is unclear whether this refers to a settings display option or automatic museum display placement.

nodes.label: Employee System
nodes.rationale: Start with 0 employees; +1 max employee per star from 2 stars on; each employee has a specific job (e.g. janitor at 1 star, bodyguard at 2) purchasable from the upgrade tree according to usefulness.

nodes.label: Lemonade & Popcorn Stands
nodes.rationale: Customers wait at stands to be served; the player grabs a cup (E), fills it from the lemonade jug (E) and serves; slow service makes customers leave a daily review.

nodes.label: Guide (G Key)
nodes.rationale: Currently a raw popup of horizontally layered text; should be a real guide.

nodes.label: Manual Fossil Display Categorization
nodes.rationale: Replace 'auto' display with manual placement the player must get right; wrong categories trigger customer complaints and extremely harsh reviews from nerds.

nodes.label: Display Validator Building
nodes.rationale: A building available very early that tells the player when a display holds a fossil in the wrong category.

nodes.label: Nerd Customers
nodes.rationale: Leave extremely harsh reviews for wrongly categorized displays.

nodes.label: Tool Equip System (LMB to Use)
nodes.rationale: Replace E-to-shovel/mine with equipping tools into the hotbar and using LMB; tools can be dropped, and lost tools can be re-equipped at the station into the inventory.

hyperedges.label: Item Management Flow (Hotbar / Inventory / Backpack / Storage)
Star-Gated Progression (Upgrade Tree, Currencies, Employees, Hotbar Slots)
